top_signals.title: Ledger hardware implant saga reaches Dubai’s Virgin Megastore
top_signals.summary: Two Ledger owners reported losing a combined $604,000 in crypto from hardware wallets they said were purchased at authorized retailer Virgin Megastore in Dubai.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Xi Calls for Deeper Cooperation and Free Trade
top_signals.summary: Xi Jinping says Asia-Pacific economies should expand trade and bilateral relations while recognizing their differences in history, culture and development. He speaks at the APEC CEO Summit in Shenzhen. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: What’s happening to crypto startup valuations?
top_signals.summary: Crypto unicorns from the 2021 boom now trade at 50% to 70% discounts in secondary markets, while the top companies hit new highs.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Coinbase AI defense blocks $4.7 million from being sent to deepfake Elon Musk scam
top_signals.summary: The company said the system prevented about 91% of the attempted transfers linked to the fake Tesla livestream, with no human intervention.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
